strategies.name: Application Exhaustion Flood Detection Across Platforms

analytics.name: Analytic 1165
analytics.guidance: Repeated invocation of high-resource application endpoints or GUI components causing CPU and memory spikes, logged as elevated request volumes, prolonged handle locks, or frequent crash recoveries.

tuning.description: Define what percentage of CPU usage indicates abnormal behavior.
Window (e.g., 5 mins) during which sustained memory usage may be abnormal.
Threshold for frequency of application faults within a specific interval.

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Application
log_sources.channel: High-frequency errors or hangs from resource-intensive application components (e.g., .NET, IIS, Office Suite)

log_sources.name: Windows:perfmon
log_sources.channel: Sudden spikes in CPU/Memory usage linked to specific application processes

analytics.name: Analytic 1166
analytics.guidance: Automated scripts or repeated CLI/API requests that trigger application backends to consume high CPU or memory (e.g., Apache/PHP, MySQL, mail servers), resulting in syslog errors and excessive process spawning.

tuning.description: Defines number of critical errors in logs within time window.
Spike rate on monitored service port triggering alert.
Rate of process creation that may overwhelm the system.

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: Error/warning logs from services indicating load spike or worker exhaustion

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Sustained abnormal inbound request rate targeting application ports (e.g., 80/443/25)

analytics.name: Analytic 1167
analytics.guidance: Repetitive triggering of GUI or backend application workflows that cause increased CPU/memory usage, logged in unified logs as spin reports or crash dumps.

tuning.description: Threshold for number of system spin/crash reports in a defined window.
Frequency of user or script reopening GUI-heavy apps.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Application errors or resource contention from excessive frontend or script invocation

log_sources.name: macos:osquery
log_sources.channel: Rapid spawning of resource-heavy applications (e.g., Preview, Safari, Office)

analytics.name: Analytic 1168
analytics.guidance: Automated abuse of cloud-hosted applications (e.g., web apps, REST endpoints, internal APIs) causing compute exhaustion, high 5xx error rates, or frequent autoscaling triggers logged in app insights or cloudwatch.

tuning.description: Ratio of 5xx error codes over requests indicating resource exhaustion.
Spike in lambda/API gateway executions indicating scripted behavior.
Triggers linked to app DoS where legitimate scaling is mimicked.

log_sources.name: AWS:CloudWatch
log_sources.channel: Elevated 5xx response rates in application logs or gateway layer

log_sources.name: AWS:CloudMetrics
log_sources.channel: Autoscaling, memory/cpu alarms, or instance unhealthiness
